rows.DesPhysicalDescription: Mummified baby crocodile. The crocodile is desiccated from the mummification process and appears black in colour. The eyes are missing, leaving empty sockets. Several teeth are visible on the proper left side of the jaw. The area from the neck down to the top of the tail has been covered in a narrow strip of coarsely woven linen. The linen strip/s has been wound around the body of the crocodile in the one direction.
